query: Which combination of methods (DiD with external market controls, synthetic controls, supply elasticity estimation, bounding) will we pre-specify to measure and correct for program-driven local price inflation, and which external price datasets will anchor these controls?

response.query: Which combination of methods (DiD with external market controls, synthetic controls, supply elasticity estimation, bounding) will we pre-specify to measure and correct for program-driven local price inflation, and which external price datasets will anchor these controls?
response.answer: We will use DiD with external market controls, synthetic controls, and bounding methods to measure local price inflation, anchored by external price datasets from ECB and World Bank.
